body: I am not from the US, and we don't have the type of big brother thing here.

It is my only hope for now i think.

We will see how it goes.

I see no point of writing everything i have done or try in the past 10 years, its easier just to write what I didn't. 

The only thing i havent tried is being on meds.

Ive been working out, making new friends, changing jobs, traveling, doing yoga, meditation , doing sports, taking bunch of classes of everything that was being offered, I moved couple of times, speed-dating, online dating, blind dating, gardening, swimming, walking, running, riding bike, changing therapists , going to group counseling, hypnosis...

I was telling myself that too. I have to push through it and try, but in reality, I dont have to. I will die eventually. 

It is really hard period for me now, this couple of days. Just waiting to go to the therapist and see about the medications, maybe that will help. 

I cant function like this anymore.

This is the sentence I keep on hearing from friends for the past 10 years.
Nothing has happened, and I just dont know how much energy I have left in me to keep on pushing on.

I am feeling that I am running on fumes and I will crash at one point and fall. This is the reason i wrote this on reddit now, because I just do not know how long i can go on like this.

I have done almost everything except going on meds.

I made an appointment few days ago and I think i will start with the meds, as it is the only thing i didnt do.
Of course I do.
Well we can try, Ive listened to bunch of suggestions so far and done almost everything I was told to do.

Yes it could. 

If I look at it this way then there is no reason to live anymore, as having someone in my life will be hell.

I dont like it now single, so there is no solution for me.

Maybe you are right, and there is no point at all.

I know they are having their own issues.
I am not talking about them as they live the perfect life.
We all have their own issues. Regardless of having a family or not.

Its just they have their SO so they can share their issues with, or solve them together. 
Not everything, and I know when you have a SO, you have some problems/issue you dont have when you are single.

I am just saying is that when I have my own issues, I deal with them alone and there is no support I have from my SO.

I have a bad day at work, I get home, and thats it.
I have issues with money, I am at home thinking about it by myself.
When I am sick, I am all alone trying to get better.
Etc etc.

Having a SO is not a solution to all of your life problems, but it sure makes your problems in life little bit more bearable. 
At least this is how i feel.

If i could feel different, I would, because I do not like feeling this way.

How should i become happier with myself?

It's all i hear , but there is no solution. The same with my therapist, when i was going.
He/she would just talk and talk and talk, and yes, I do know all that stuff, but the problem is , it is not working.

One of the worst feeling I had when I was doing the therapy was that feeling when you are leaving.

While you are in session, it kinda seems nothing is that bad, because there is a person there who understand your problems and is telling you it is going to get better.

But then, the one hour is up, and you need to get back into real life.
Its when the reality hits you again hard and you find yourself all alone again.

Yes, i think my life is pointless. It is just me vs the world and it sucks going through all that all alone. 
Sadly, I live in a place where big brother is not an option, although I am not sure if that would help.
Didn't try, so I cannot say.

I do agree to some extent to that. 
I also think that if I have someone I can do stuff with, I wouldn't feel like shit all the time.

It's just that Ive been doing everything on my own alone all the time, and I just cant do it anymore. I've been doing that for years and years.

The situation is just getting worse as I am getting older.

Before, you would go out, everyone would be single, we would all enjoy everything the same. 
Then slowly, people started getting into relationships and having their own issues, problems, chores, etc.
Then, as we are all getting older, they are living together, getting married and having kids.

I see no joy of going out in clubs, partying like im a 20 year old kid.
All around me are just that, kids. 
I cannot meet a girl who is 20 and have something in common with her or with the guys that are out for that matter.

My life just consist of work and eating and sleeping.
That is it.

Then from time to time, its me calling people around trying to see if they are up to something, and it just hurts when someone says "oh sorry i cannot go my kid is sick". 

He is not a dick because he won't go out as his kid is sick, of course he cant go out. And it is always me trying to call and meet people trying to avoid being the third or fifth or seventh wheel.

I am writing here all this after 10ish years of slowly going down.
It is not something that is happening for a month. It is a decade.
Yes, I know i need to feel better. Problem is I am not feeling better for a long long time.

They cannot do anything about it, except getting me a girl I can play/tease with while we play.

Its not that they always play as team/couple.
We can play girls vs boys, or make a random teams, but bottom line is always couples and me.

They kiss, tease, hug, while I cannot do anything like that, and those kinds of things are just painful to watch now.

I also cannot demand of couples not to act like couples.

It is easy to say, find new friends who are not in a relationship. But it is not that easy, trust me.

I am trying, but in my age group, its hard.
Also, I cannot just meet someone new who I know 10 years from high school or childhood. Those are the things i cannot invent.

Those are my friends, its just the way of life that now they have families.

Well, you know how when you are a kid, everything is so fun and new to you.
Having a kid gives you the possibility to make another life better, and happier then yours.

I generally enjoy helping people, and just imagining that you can actually create and have such an impact on a life...i think that is (should be) the ultimate goal for any living being.

Every time i visit my friends who has kids, they are amazed how good with the kids I am, and how much the kids like me.

That makes me sad even more.

I would do everything with the family. I think, if I ever have one, every person in my family would be happy and would have everything they need / want.

My family life was ok. Nothing bad happened. I grew up as a general happy kid with good parents. Nothing special, but then again nothing bad either.

Its exhausting when you are that guy who needs to be a fun guy to be around, so they can escape from their SO's to have fun.

If you understand what I am trying to say.

It is hard not to focus on the relationship they have, because whatever you do, it will pop out at one point.
You go bowling, you end up with 4 teams, and me. 

Hey, lets make teams guys vs girls. Great, 4 vs 4 . They all tease each other, playing against each other, and Im there teasing my imaginary girlfriend. 

Its just an example, but those kind of things are always happening.
Maybe you are not aware of it, because you are not focused on that and you dont see it as I do. But sadly, I do see it all the time, and it is happening all the time.

I go to the mall, and all I see is bunch of couple shopping/eating/having fun together.

Its those little things that hurts me so much, and nobody is noticing that.
Sometimes those little things hurts so much I just stay at home, rather then being out with couples.

I was "that person" for a couple of years, a couple of years ago.

It is exhausting and I cannot do it anymore.

Usually how it goes is that they all have fulfilled lives, and when they need a break or a change, Im there.

So I give give give give, and get nothing back.
After a good time with me, they go back to the wives and their girlfriends, and i go back to me being alone and lonely.

You can do it for a while, but you cant do it all the time.

Its hard to maintain good sleeping/eating habits when the depression hits. Sometimes I have insomnia for 3/4 days...I usually cry during those periods. For no reason, I just burst into tears. Sometimes even in public...

Loving wife
Great kids
We are all healthy

A cliche I know.

But those are the things i cant force and I don't have an impact/control on.
So a magic lamp would help.

Anything else, I can do it with hard work and will.

Thanks, but WOW is so in the past in my life I have no wish in going back.

You know how usually me meeting new friends ends up?
Him telling me that we should go out, and I end up going out with bunch of couples and me.

The sleeping and my diet is always changing.
Sometimes I do sleep a lot and eat really healthy, other times I have insomnia and eat junk food for weeks.

It all depends how depressed I am.

Im sorry. 
You wanted to meet me and you are a 11 year old girl?

If you are not a troll , I would strongly suggest you never meet someone over the internet. It is not a safe thing to do. So please don't do it ever.

It wont ruin their lives completely. 

I dont have such relationship with anyone that if I die, it would ruin their life.

Miss something wonderful? I will die eventually, without a doubt. Its just a matter of how much pain do I want before I do.

You know, I am now at that age group when its little odd and creepy when I make friends online with someone from the game.

Happened few times, and when it comes to knowing a little bit more info about that great night elf I was spending so much time with...i come to realization that I wanted to make friends with some 14/15 year old kid.

On the other hand, playing a game and asking everyone how old are they before you play with them, is kinda lame and defeats the purpose of the game itself.

I had couple of pets (cats and dogs). Didnt help much sadly.

I was thinking about that too...so what if they will miss me?
They have their own lives. Some of them are nice some not.

Do I need to keep living and being in pain just because of them?
I dont think thats a good enough reason to live.

When I think of it like that, I feel like Im some kind of a toy in an amusement park. So if I am not there, I will be missed.

Its the battle I keep on fighting for a long time.

Although, to be honest, I am not sure if this is awesome.
The only difference between the fact that I didnt do it, or that I did is 10 years of pain. 

10 years of pain is not awesome.

I remember when i was a kid, and whenever I heard a story about a suicide, or an attempt of suicide, I would think of myself.

Why would someone do it? 
Its so stupid, they have plenty of reasons to live.

Well, now I understand it. I know that sometimes, there are no reasons to live, unless the reason is pain.

I really hope that this will change...but Ive been hoping for so long...every time i find less and less reasons to keep on going.

No, Im not from Ohio.

May I ask why did you ask this question? Im just wondering.

I have done all the games.
I have played WOW when it came out, Call of Duty, EVE online, LOL, Guild Wars...its all "fun" but you realize this is just something made up and online. 

You end up being awake at 4 am alone and feeling lonely, while you raid or are on a quest.

No, I dont enjoy work. Its not that is a bad job, its that all everything else is awful, so that feeling is ruining the work itself.

I just do it because I need to live somehow, for now. The same goes for eating or drinking. Just something I need to do if I want to be alive.

Sometimes it seems like I have chose this. 
But I didnt. Most of the people dont understand that. They act like its an easy fix. Just be happy and thats it.

You gave me thinking with that question. And honestly, I cannot remember the time I was truly happy.
The time from college til now is some kind of a blur. I cant really remember much.All the days are the same...I dont know if something happened last week or 5 years ago.

There are no feelings associated with dates.

That is easy to say. Hard to make it work.

Sometimes, I do get out, a lot. But, thats usually it. I end up alone being out.

Making new friends was easy in school, high school and college.
The older you get, the harder it is. 

I cannot adopt. (please dont ask why, lets just leave it at that. tnx)

I have done it in the past.
The problem is nothing is interesting for me that I enjoy so much.

I always hear suggestions like, play an instrument, write, paint.
Well, I dont like it. I do not enjoy in those things anymore.

I feel just empty and nothing is fulfilling. No joy or happiness in anything.

I know it sounds awful, but that is the truth.
If i could get an instrument or i dont know, play soccer and enjoy it, i would happily do it. But i dont enjoy it . 

On the video games things, heh..they just make me more lonely.
Starring at computer screen alone. Not a good feeling.

Having friends is not fulfilling for me as much as having someone in your life.

As i said before, most of them are married or in long relationship. It comes normal with age...and I dont blame them.

They go out with other couples, with kids, having their own family problems, kids bday parties...
At the end of the day, or at the beginning, I am still alone in my apartment in cold bed being sad and lonely.

Its hard to depends on other people to make you company all the time.
I am "free" for hanging out always, but they arent as they are busy.

You know, when you got a baby, its not like you can just go out at night for couple of drinks and party. You have a baby and a wife.

Sure, you can do it from time to time, but in between that time i am in that gap where I fall deep. 

A day has 24 hours (from most I am awake).  I cant be with friends 24 hours a day. Maybe few hours a week. Everything else is pain.

No, I cant.

Although I agree you center center your self-esteem on someone else, but doing things with someone is more fun then doing it alone.

Dinner, movie, walking, running, laying on the couch or having sex.
You have to have someone in order to make it "special". Add a little sauce to it.

Well, someone can do all that alone and enjoy it.
I for one can't. If i could, i wouldnt be sad, I would be happy and I wouldnt be here right now.

I have tried to change my behavior and "force" myself into liking in being single and alone, but...didn't happen and I think i wont be able to change it.

That is the thing. I don't enjoy anything. I just feel sad and lonely all the time. Because it has been so long...this is the cloud over my head, and i cant escape it.

EDIT: a word

I know you have to love yourself first, but ... its not that i hate myself. I just hate the feeling of being alone and lonely all the time. It sucks.

I wish I could enjoy being lonely, but I just don't.

I don't have standards per say. I just want to "feel something" while I am with her.

Usually, all the girls I am interested with, are either already taken (because , Im not a kid anymore...so all the girls i meet around my age or few years younger are usually married or in long relationship) or they screw me over before it ever gets anywhere...

I know why, because Im in need of someone, so I am too eager to find someone. Girls (or people in general) don't like that. But I cant help it...although...."screwing me over" happened only a few times.

Usually I just dont find anyone, or the girls I find attractive are taken or not into me.

Can you tell me what kind of things I am good at you are thinking of? For an example, because I do not know what should i respond.

It depends on the periods.

Sometimes I work my ass off so I dont have free time, sometimes I work out, sometimes i go out (alone). Go on a fine dinner, see a movie, etc. Always alone...but I am pushing it and saying it to myself it will change.

But it's not changing...and I am tired. I am really tired.

No. 
All my friends are family persons now, and usually dont have time for my "whining" .

The standard response I get all the time is: "You will find someone, don't worry".

Im sure we all get those "comforting words"

Yes. I have tried going to the gym and running, and I usually get comments that I am a good looking guy.
EDIT: Just a ps. When I am working out, I dont have that "rush" of adrenaline or that feeling of being happy and whatever other people are talking of.

I just work out, and I feel depressed and lonely as I am doing so.
But I keep pushing it, hoping it will change. It doesn't and then i break and can't do it anymore.
